purpose: Define the only permitted metadata surface for screening a Palearctic terrestrial-insect subpanel from the 211 final phylogatR survivors without reading species-level genetic outcomes.
allowed_information: final response-blind survivor identity from the pre-Phase4 authorization
occurrence latitude-longitude associated with those headers
canonical/noncanonical character-support survivor status already fixed before Phase4
historical_context_disclosure: The global 211-species empirical result has already been opened and is known. This new subpanel analysis is therefore a prospectively specified targeted secondary analysis, not an untouched confirmatory experiment. Species-level outcomes are nevertheless withheld from subpanel eligibility and TTF-Q qualification.
